meta.title: Mac Sync Progress - Multi-branch Worktree Feature

scope_today.primary_goal: Implement same-repo multi-branch parallel workspace with session binding, without polluting original repo folder
scope_today.secondary_goal: Fix UX/regression issues found during live user validation

timeline_steps.problem: Need branch-level parallel workspaces independent from original repo folder
timeline_steps.root_cause: No dedicated worktree creation pipeline in project routes/UI
changes: Added backend API POST /api/projects/:projectName/create-branch-worktree
Uses git worktree add and auto-registers resulting path as a project
Stores worktree metadata in project config

timeline_steps.problem: Non-git projects should be compatible and not show invalid actions
changes: Added isGitRepo detection in backend project aggregation
Extended project type with isGitRepo flag
Hide create-branch-workspace action for non-git projects
Controller guard: reject action if project is not git

timeline_steps.problem: Worktree default path was C:\Users\... and could cause long-path failures
timeline_steps.root_cause: Default root path fallback used home directory-based location
changes: Added worktree settings API: GET/PUT /api/projects/worktree-settings
Persist settings to ~/.openwork/worktree-settings.json
If root path not configured, branch creation returns WORKTREE_ROOT_NOT_CONFIGURED
Frontend flow now asks for root path first, then saves and retries creation

timeline_steps.problem: Windows path too long during git worktree checkout
timeline_steps.root_cause: Long branch + deep java package path exceeded filesystem limits
changes: Changed generated worktree directory naming to short readable alias + hash
Reduced path depth while retaining branch identity traceability

timeline_steps.problem: Need root-level mapping document between generated folders and actual project/branch
timeline_steps.root_cause: Short directory names reduce direct readability
changes: Auto-maintain worktree-map.md and worktree-map.json under configured root
Mapping fields: directory, project, branch, source repo path, timestamps

timeline_steps.problem: Child worktree was shown as top-level sibling instead of under parent project
timeline_steps.root_cause: Sidebar list rendered flat project array
changes: Implemented grouped rendering in sidebar
isGitWorktree + sourceProjectName projects are rendered under parent project
Child list shown when parent is expanded

timeline_steps.problem: After grouping, actions looked broken; expanding child collapsed parent and blocked session creation
timeline_steps.root_cause: Project expand logic was single-select (replace set) instead of toggle multi-expand
changes: Changed toggleProject to additive toggle on Set (multi-expand compatible)
Parent no longer collapses when interacting with child nodes

timeline_steps.problem: Need actionable backend diagnostics for branch creation failures
timeline_steps.root_cause: Generic command failure message lost useful stderr details
changes: Branch creation failure response now includes stderr-based details and code
Helps identify concrete causes (e.g. filename too long)

new_or_updated_api_contracts.purpose: Read current configured worktree root path
Save worktree root path before creating branch workspaces
Create branch worktree and register as project

project_list: Non-git project: no branch-worktree action button
Worktree project: shown as child under source project
Parent/child expand states do not conflict
create_flow: If worktree root missing, prompt for root path and persist
Update mapping docs under configured root

notes: Known existing css minify warnings remain (pre-existing), not introduced by this feature
Live user validation confirms branch creation works and child node can now create sessions

must_sync: Branch worktree creation API with detailed stderr returns
Sidebar parent-child grouping and multi-expand toggle fix
mac_adaptation_points: Path normalization and compare logic for POSIX paths
Default prompt examples should use /Users/.../worktree style
Keep behavior parity: do not create worktrees under original repo folder

ui_parity_spec_for_mac.goal: Mac UI should be near-identical to current Windows UX for multi-branch worktree feature

structure: Indented child worktree rows under parent when parent expanded
rules: Child row appears only when isGitWorktree=true and sourceProjectName maps to visible parent
Child rows are rendered in a left-indented container with subtle left border
Parent collapse hides all child rows

mobile_action_order: create branch workspace (git icon, only for git projects)
visibility_rules: create branch workspace action visible only when project.isGitRepo || project.isGitWorktree
for non-git projects action must be hidden, not disabled

branch_badge.style: inline, tiny blue badge with git icon

expand_logic: expanding child must not auto-collapse parent
expanding one parent must not auto-collapse other parents
click_targets: row main area toggles current row expand/collapse
icon buttons must stop event propagation
new_session_path: new session creates under selected child branch project context

current_behavior: if worktree root missing, prompt for root path and save
create branch workspace and refresh sidebar
required_parity: same trigger entry point and same sequence on Mac
same error messaging priority: details > error > fallback text
future_improvement_recommended: replace browser prompt with dedicated modal form on both platforms for strict visual parity

icons: use same GitBranch icon size classes as Windows implementation
use same color tokens for action icon containers
hover_and_focus: keep hover opacity transitions and rounded hit area
preserve touch opacity behavior for mobile/touch devices
typography: same text size classes for project name and metadata
branch badge text should remain compact and not wrap

acceptance_checklist: On Mac, create branch action appears exactly where it appears on Windows
Parent-child visual nesting matches Windows spacing and border treatment
Child project can be selected and used to create new session
Expanding/collapsing does not cause parent-child state conflicts
Non-git projects show no branch action and no dead clicks
Worktree branch badge display matches Windows size/color/placement

ui_execution_playbook_for_mac.objective: Translate parity spec into implementation tasks that can be executed component-by-component with measurable outcomes

component_mapping.mac_target: Mirror render structure and class hierarchy 1:1 where possible

component_mapping.feature: Row actions and git-worktree button visibility
component_mapping.mac_target: Keep action order, hit area, icon size and visibility gates identical

component_mapping.feature: Expand/collapse behavior and branch creation flow
component_mapping.mac_target: Reuse same state transition logic (set-based toggle), avoid single-select regressions

must_hold_rules: Child interaction never collapses parent implicitly
Switching selection does not reset expanded set unexpectedly
Creation success always triggers sidebar refresh and keeps parent navigable

visual_parity_thresholds.hover_opacity_behavior: must match timing/easing profile of Windows implementation

copy_and_i18n_rules.default_language_behavior: Respect current app language and never fallback to hardcoded English in Chinese locale
copy_and_i18n_rules.new_keys_policy: All new sidebar/worktree keys must be added to en/zh-CN/ja/ko in the same commit
copy_and_i18n_rules.fallback_policy: If key missing, log warning and fallback to existing translated generic message before raw key

qa_checklist_for_release: Screenshot compare: parent collapsed/expanded, child selected, hover state
Behavior compare: create branch workspace flow including root-path prompt path
Regression test: open parent, click child actions, create new session under child
Localization test: zh-CN labels and modal texts are fully translated
Cross-platform sanity: same scenario run on Windows and Mac produces equivalent navigation results
non_regression_boundaries: Do not change existing terminal/chat switching flow while applying sidebar parity
Do not modify provider command semantics (new session vs resume session)
Do not force git-only assumptions onto non-git projects

known_risks_and_followups.risk: Using prompt dialogs for root/branch input is functional but not ideal UX
known_risks_and_followups.suggested_followup: Replace with dedicated modal form with validation and recent-path memory

known_risks_and_followups.risk: Existing i18n locale files contain encoding issues in some language packs
known_risks_and_followups.suggested_followup: Normalize locale file encoding and add keys for new worktree messages

known_risks_and_followups.risk: Very deep repositories may still hit path limits in extreme branch/path cases
known_risks_and_followups.suggested_followup: Add optional ultra-short mode and root-depth warning

user_confirmed: Main regression (parent collapse blocking child actions) fixed
